name: Faith Singer
summary: Faith singers show their faith in their deity with songs or other appropriate performances.

features.name: Faithful Deity
features.summary: Choose the deity worshiped by the Faith Singer.

features.name: Faithful Alignment
features.summary: Choose an alignment within one step of the selected deity.

features.name: Devout Domain
features.summary: Choose one domain granted by the selected deity.

features.name: 1st-level Devout Domain Spell
features.summary: Select the 1st-level spell from the chosen domain. Cast it once per day as a spell-like ability at Bard caster level while giving a bardic performance.

features.name: 2nd-level Devout Domain Spell
features.summary: Select the 2nd-level spell from the chosen domain. Cast it once per day as a spell-like ability at Bard caster level while giving a bardic performance.

features.name: 3rd-level Devout Domain Spell
features.summary: Select the 3rd-level spell from the chosen domain. Cast it once per day as a spell-like ability at Bard caster level while giving a bardic performance.

features.name: 4th-level Devout Domain Spell
features.summary: Select the 4th-level spell from the chosen domain. Cast it once per day as a spell-like ability at Bard caster level while giving a bardic performance.

features.name: 5th-level Devout Domain Spell
features.summary: Select the 5th-level spell from the chosen domain. Cast it once per day as a spell-like ability at Bard caster level while giving a bardic performance.

mechanicalNotes: Deity and one-step alignment legality, deity-granted domain filtering, all five level-gated domain spells, daily cast status, and Bard-level spell-like caster guidance are automated.
